      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair (fun x : List Bool => x) eliminate ∧
      ∀ (x : ℕ) (φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF), ∃ ψ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, eliminate (PEqualNP.Search.encodeLiteral (x,true),PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ) = PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF ψ ∧
        {c : PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause ℕ | ∃ d ∈ ψ, d.toFinset = c} =
